channel.title: FAIRNESS & ACCURACY IN REPORTING - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from FAIRNESS & ACCURACY IN REPORTING (fair.org)

item.title: Setareh Ghandehari on ICE Violence, Jon Schleuss on Pittsburgh Paper Shutdown
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security wants us all to think “immigration equals crime.” What happens if we do that? What would happen if we didn’t?

item.title: Dedrick Asante-Muhammad on State of the Dream 2026
item.description: The elite press corps that now pretend they honor Martin Luther King show that they never understood him—or those who share his vision today.

item.title: Jenna Ruddock on DHS Domestic Surveillance
item.description: People who never called themselves "political" are moving out of their comfort zone to register their opposition to violent, state-sanctioned power.

item.title: Rayan El Amine on Voices From Gaza
item.description: The voices of Palestinians themselves are an intervention into a media conversation that presents Palestinians as subjects more often than as actors.

item.title: Ari Berman on Attacks on Voting
item.description: Some media still present changes to the electoral process that would make it harder for millions of people to vote as a matter of "election integrity."

item.title: Reed Lindsay on the War on Cuba
item.description: The Trump White House is openly trying to harm the Cuban people, and US media are openly trying to sell that to us as something to root for.

item.title: Naomi Bethune on Anti-Black History Month?
item.description: In the words of Ida B. Wells: “The people must know before they can act, and there is no educator to compare with the press.”

item.title: Gregory Shupak on the US War on Iran
item.description: It’s hard to parse US corporate news coverage of the attacks on Iran if you aren’t willing to let go of the idea that might does not, in fact, make right.

item.title: A History of Iran Propaganda
item.description: CounterSpin has been tracking US news media failings, omissions and propagandizing on Iran for decades. We revisit some of that conversation this week.

item.title: Jim Naureckas on MAGA vs. 1st Amendment, Baher Azmy on Abu Ghraib Justice
item.description: If we cut off our ability to have a widespread public debate, whatever “solutions” we’re told “we” came up with have nothing to do with democracy.
